_note: Updated 2026-10-26 through D-028. New reference screenshots replay the frozen 4-turn TTS output through app ed12b8f offscreen; they do not measure new latency. Earlier media and video remain explicitly dated 2026-10-25. Sources: docs/showcase-ja.md and tests/live_suggest/showcase-replay-20261026-200255.json. Local only; not deployed. D-027 adds folder selection and live refresh; materials window renders a public TTS source snapshot. verification.ja: 通用資料4問TTSの非表示Canvas完了p95は2.73秒。可視表示の新しい合格を意味せず、D-023の別の可視10問はp95 3.59秒で未達。第三者試用と母語話者レビューは未実施。
verification.zh: 通用资料4问TTS的隐藏Canvas完成p95为2.73秒，不等于可见显示达标；D-023的另一次可见10问p95为3.59秒，仍未达标。第三方试用与母语者审阅尚未完成。
verification.en: Four document TTS turns reached hidden Canvas completion at p95 2.73 s, not visible-display acceptance. A separate D-023 visible 10-turn run reached p95 3.59 s and missed the target. No third-party or native-speaker review yet.

change.ja: 2 文の録音だけで認識モデルを替え、後で 1 文まるごと捏造する失敗を見つけた。次は少数の結果で決めず、保存した実音声で再生して確かめてから変える。
change.zh: 只凭 2 句录音就换了识别模型，后来才发现它会把一整段话编成套话。下次不凭少量结果下结论，先用保存的真实录音重放确认再改。
change.en: I switched the recognition model on just two recorded sentences and only later found it could replace a whole sentence with a stock phrase. Next time: replay saved real audio before changing anything.
